correctness.rationale: The paper's own coefficient calculation is the Hankel matrix (alpha_{j+k}); the explicit H^2 sequence alpha_m=(m+1)^(-3/4) gives an H^2 input whose output coefficients are bounded below by a constant times j^(-1/2), hence not square summable. Classical Nehari--Fefferman/Hartman theory gives the BMOA/VMOA thresholds.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The BMOA/VMOA criterion is classical and not claimed new. Searches found no public correction of Lemma 2.1 of arXiv:2609.19311v1 or equivalent application of the Hankel criterion to that claim; the SCOPE archive showed no overlap.

value.rationale: The false lemma is explicitly introduced as a mechanism for Proposition 2.2 and subsequent projection-rigidity claims, so identifying the gap is scientifically material; the record also supplies an exact regularity boundary and a quantitative blow-up witness.
